answer: A Sybil defense that bites gates identity with a scarce, non-transferable credential bound one-to-one to a verified human root. An agent must attach it to its first bond; it cannot be sold or reused, so a second agent needs a second real human. A shielded relay pool lets newcomers hide in an anonymous nebula of traffic, yet each slot demands a fresh bond locked for epochs and slashed on lies. Cloning costs a full bond plus forfeiture risk per extra identity, so n fakes cost about n bonds. Honest work clears the stake like a calm zephyr; a fake swarm burns capital under sable risk.
